effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
purpose: I run a high-end interior design and renovation firm, and we are entering a business development and referral partnership with a luxury real estate team that says they can consistently bring us renovation clients for kitchens, baths, whole-home remodels, staging upgrades, and turnkey furnishing packages. Right now everything has been handled through calls, texts, and informal promises, so I need a serious agreement between my company and their team. We need a $10,000 monthly retainer plus 7% commission on signed projects they directly source, payable only after the client deposit clears, with clawback if the client cancels within 45 days. They may use approved photos, videos, drone footage, design boards, staging photos, ad creatives, and social clips, but all CRM lead data, landing pages, paid ad accounts, campaign data, and customer information remain our property unless expressly transferred in writing. They only get exclusivity in our metro if they deliver at least 10 qualified leads per month. We also need reimbursement rules for approved travel, events, and paid ads; confidentiality around pricing, margins, vendors, and customer lists; non-circumvention; non-solicit; approval rights for promotions and testimonials; FTC-compliant advertising language; morals and reputation clause; term and auto-renewal; termination for nonperformance or scandal; survival of confidentiality and payment obligations; dispute resolution; Delaware governing law; and a clean tracked review/redline flow before final e-signature.
title: Consulting Agreement
